events.title: BoJ hikes 25bp to 1.25% (31-year high)
events.why_it_matters: A 7-2 hike to 1.25% one session after the Warsh Fed completes G3 tightening and is the classic yen-carry unwind trigger with oil imports already stressing Japan's trade balance.
events.what_to_watch: Ueda press conference tone, JGB/yen spike, and whether global risk assets treat this as a one-and-done or the start of a faster BoJ path.

events.title: IRGC strikes/detains Togo-flagged tanker in Hormuz
events.why_it_matters: A fresh IRGC strike on a commercial tanker keeps the 2026 Hormuz tanker war live even as Brent eased to ~$102–103, reminding markets the $100 oil premium is a war premium not a demand story.
events.what_to_watch: UKMTO/AIS transit counts, US/allied retaliation, and whether weekend Bessent–He Iran talks produce any de-escalation language.

events.title: Electra Therapeutics (ETRA) IPO begins trading
events.why_it_matters: Upsized ~$350M clinical-stage biotech IPO at $15 is the window's risk-appetite test after Holtec pulled its nuclear listing into a hawkish-rate tape.
events.what_to_watch: Day-one pop/discount versus the $14–16 range and whether other biotech filings re-open or stay frozen.

events.title: SEMICON India 2026 (New Delhi)
events.why_it_matters: Modi-opened 600-exhibitor chip gathering (ASML, Applied, Micron, Tata) is the live diversification/CapEx signal while AI demand stays hot and governments push away from single-node risk.
events.what_to_watch: Semicon 2.0 subsidy/tool-order headlines on the final day (Sept 19) and any US/Japan/Korea partnership MOUs.

events.title: Taiwan joint attack-drone drill; PLA activity spike
events.why_it_matters: Taipei's first multi-type attack-drone joint drill and a mid-September PLA air/naval spike one week before Trump–Xi keep Taiwan/semiconductor tail risk in the summit tape.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PLA sorties escalate into the Sept 24 visit window and any US arms/Taiwan language in Trump's UNGA or Xi bilateral.

events.title: Bessent–He Lifeng pre-summit talks (New York)
events.why_it_matters: Weekend Treasury–Vice Premier talks are the last working-level shot at teeing up ~$30bn reciprocal tariff cuts, ag purchases, rare earths, AI, and Iran-finance issues before Sept 24.
events.what_to_watch: Any readout on a one-year Busan-truce extension (expires Nov 10) versus a walk-away that would reprice China tariffs and oil.

events.title: PBOC September LPR fix — hold expected
events.why_it_matters: Reuters' 21-economist survey is unanimous for a 16th straight hold at 3.00%/3.50% even as FAI and consumption wilt, confirming Beijing will not offset G3 hikes with a big easing.
events.what_to_watch: Any surprise 5y LPR cut (mortgages) would be the property-relief signal; a hold into the Xi visit is the base case.

events.title: AutoZone Q4 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Best high-frequency read on US consumer trade-down and DIY auto spend into a rate-hike/oil-shock tape; Street ~$54.42 EPS / ~$6.71bn sales.
events.what_to_watch: Same-store sales, gross margin vs. mix, and FY27 guidance if gasoline and rates are stealing wallet share.

events.title: UNGA 81 high-level debate; Trump speech
events.why_it_matters: Trump speaks the morning of Sept 22 (after Brazil) overlapping the Xi visit and Iran/IAEA track; Hormuz, China, and Ukraine remarks can move oil, defense, and tariff-sensitive names.
events.what_to_watch: Any new red lines on Hormuz transits, secondary Russia/Iran tariffs, or Taiwan language ahead of Sept 24.

events.title: General Mills, Cintas, Paychex Q1 prints
events.why_it_matters: GIS (~$0.72 EPS / ~$4.34bn) is the packaged-food inflation/volume tell; CTAS/PAYX (~$1.35 and ~$1.32 EPS) read US employment and small-business demand after the Warsh hike.
events.what_to_watch: GIS volume vs. price, Cintas facility/uniform trends, Paychex worksite and float income vs. higher rates.

events.title: Trump–Xi Washington summit
events.why_it_matters: Highest-stakes trade event of the quarter: tariffs, rare earths, AI, Taiwan arms, and the Iran war, with the Nov 10, 2026 Busan truce expiry looming and US midterms six weeks out.
events.what_to_watch: Concrete tariff-cut list vs. photo-op only; any Taiwan/Iran paragraph that reprices chips, defense, and oil.

events.title: Costco Q4 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Membership-club bellwether for middle-income spending power as gasoline, rates, and food inflation squeeze real incomes; consensus ~$6.55 EPS / ~$94.9bn sales.
events.what_to_watch: US comparable sales ex-gas, membership renewal/fee mix, and any traffic warning into Q1 holiday.

events.title: Darden Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Casual-dining bellwether (Olive Garden et al.) for lower/middle-income dine-out as energy and rates bite; Street ~$2.05 EPS / ~$3.21bn sales.
events.what_to_watch: Same-restaurant sales, traffic vs. check, and commodity/labor guidance.

events.title: US August new home sales
events.why_it_matters: Follows Lennar's order/margin miss, 3.98M existing-home sales, and another starts/permits drop; consensus ~610k SAAR after July's 607k collapse.
events.what_to_watch: A sub-600k print would confirm builders cannot offset the Warsh-rate shock with incentives.

events.title: US Section 338 import bans on selected Canadian goods
events.why_it_matters: Sept 8 proclamations escalate the Canada tit-for-tat from 50% tariffs (modified Sept 15) to outright bans on specified beer/wine/spirits, some dairy/whey, and motorcycles effective 12:01 a.m. ET Sept 29.
events.what_to_watch: Last-minute scope carve-outs, Canadian retaliation add-ons, and auto/motorcycle supply-chain noise.

events.title: JOLTS August job openings
events.why_it_matters: Labor-demand read the day before PCE/GDP; a still-tight openings print would validate the Warsh Fed's 'resilient activity, elevated inflation' hike path.
events.what_to_watch: Openings vs. quits and whether the jobs-workers gap is re-widening after August payrolls +162k.

events.title: August PCE + Q2 GDP third estimate
events.why_it_matters: Fed's preferred gauge is nowcast ~3.7–3.8% headline / ~3.3% core YoY after the energy shock; GDP third estimate expected unrevised at +1.5% annualized — a hawkish mix if both print as expected.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE m/m vs. TD's +0.24% and any annual-revision surprise in the GDP accounts.

events.title: Micron Q4 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Memory-cycle bellwether into Korea's export boom (DRAM/NAND prices +250% YoY in some BOK data); a blowout FQ1 guide would confirm the AI-memory supercycle is still running through G3 tightening.
events.what_to_watch: HBM/DRAM pricing, data-center mix, and whether capex is still being raised into 2027.

events.title: Nike Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Global brand/China-demand and wholesale-cleanup tell for discretionary goods as US rates and oil squeeze the consumer; Street ~$0.44–0.45 EPS.
events.what_to_watch: North America vs. Greater China growth, inventory, and full-year margin guide.

events.title: US September employment report
events.why_it_matters: First labor print of the Warsh tightening phase; consensus ~+140k NFP and unemployment steady near 4.2% after August's +162k / 4.1%.
events.what_to_watch: A 200k+ / wage-hot print would cement another 25bp by year-end; a sub-100k miss would reopen the growth-scare debate.

events.title: Warsh Fed +25bp to 3.75–4.00% with hawkish SEP
events.why_it_matters: Unanimous first hike since 2023; 16/18 dots show another 25bp by year-end and inflation projections were revised higher — the rate path, not the 25bp, is still moving duration and housing.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Sept 30 PCE and Oct 2 payrolls keep the December hike fully priced.

events.title: BoE holds 3.75% in hawkish 6–3 split
events.why_it_matters: Hold matched the ~75–80% priced base case, but Pill/Greene/Mann dissented for +25bp with CPI at 3.1% and energy-war upside — UK rates stay a two-way risk.
events.what_to_watch: Whether November MPC flips if Hormuz keeps fuel inflation elevated toward 4% in early 2027.

events.title: US August housing starts/permits miss
events.why_it_matters: Starts 1.275M SAAR (−2.6%) and permits 1.394M (−2.7%) failed to rebound toward the ~1.30–1.31M / ~1.40–1.41M consensus, confirming rate-sensitive construction is still contracting.
events.what_to_watch: Sept 24 new-home sales as the next confirmation; single-family starts did bounce, so the miss was multifamily-led.

events.title: ECB +25bp to 2.50% deposit rate
events.why_it_matters: Second 2026 hike, driven by Middle East energy inflation (staff 3.0%/2.5%/2.1% HICP path), keeps euro-area financial conditions tightening into October 28–29.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Oct 29 is another hike if oil stays >$100.

events.title: House passes Graham Russia/Iran sanctions bill
events.why_it_matters: H.R. 5334 (262–159) heads to Trump with authority for up to 100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian oil/gas (China, India) plus Iran Sanctions Act extension through 2031.
events.what_to_watch: Signing timing vs. the Xi summit; even unused, the 100% secondary-tariff option is a China/India equity and oil-flow overhang.

events.title: Google ad-tech remedies: no breakup, 6-year conduct rules
events.why_it_matters: Judge Brinkema rejected AdX divestiture but unsealed worldwide interoperability, Prebid integration, and anti-self-preferencing remedies — a publisher-ad-tech reset without a structural GOOG hit.
events.what_to_watch: Final judgment language, 60-day vs. 12–15 month implementation, and whether DOJ/Google appeal.

events.title: China August activity: IP firm, demand collapsing
events.why_it_matters: IP +5.2% YoY vs. retail +0.4% and Jan–Aug FAI −7.2% / property investment −19.9% is the two-speed China that makes a Trump–Xi deal necessary for Beijing and less stimulative for global commodities.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the summit produces property/credit easing or just export-for-tariff bargains.

events.title: Hormuz tanker war / oil >$100 (ongoing)
events.why_it_matters: Strait transits remain a fraction of peacetime (~3 AIS-visible on Sept 16 vs. ~85/day); Brent still ~$102 after a $104–105 spike, feeding G3 inflation and the Warsh/ECB/BoJ hike cluster.
events.what_to_watch: Daily transit recovery, Oman-mediated talks (already slipped), and any US kinetic response to today's tanker strike.

events.title: OPEC+ holds October quotas unchanged
events.why_it_matters: Seven core producers paused further unwind of cuts for October as Hormuz disruptions already tighten physical barrels; next review is Oct 4 (just outside this window).
events.what_to_watch: Compliance vs. spare-capacity rhetoric if Brent slips back through $100 on any ceasefire headline.

events.title: US housing demand crack (Lennar + existing sales)
events.why_it_matters: Lennar cut FY deliveries to 80–81k on order (−9% YoY) and margin pressure; existing-home sales 3.98M SAAR with 4.9 months' supply — housing is the domestic transmission of Warsh tightening.
events.what_to_watch: Sept 24 new-home sales and mortgage-rate backup after the SEP.

events.title: August CPI/PPI energy shock still in the tape
events.why_it_matters: CPI +0.4% m/m / +3.4% YoY with gasoline +3.9%; PPI final demand +0.4% / +5.4% YoY — the oil war is already in US inflation and was cited in the Warsh hike.
events.what_to_watch: Sept 30 PCE pass-through; another month of $100 oil would keep December hike odds elevated.

events.title: August retail sales rebound +1.2%
events.why_it_matters: Nominal sales $773.9bn beat (~+0.8% expected) with control-group +1.4%, but gasoline +3.1% and a 6% YoY print mean some of the 'resilience' is the oil bill — still enough to justify Fed hawkishness.
events.what_to_watch: Costco/AutoZone/Darden real-volume tells next week vs. this nominal bounce.

events.title: SEC 5-year tokenized-securities 'innovation exemption'
events.why_it_matters: Chair Atkins' conditional exemption lets Tokenized Securities Venues trade tokenized NMS stocks on-chain without full exchange registration — a structural market-structure shift, not a one-day tape event.
events.what_to_watch: Which brokers/venues actually launch, issuer opt-outs, and volume caps in the first 90 days.

events.title: FCC clears foreign funding in Paramount–Warner deal
events.why_it_matters: Section 310(b)(4) declaratory ruling with foreign-influence limits unblocks a mega-cap media combination that had been a financing/regulatory overhang.
events.what_to_watch: Remaining DOJ/state conditions and whether content/data restrictions bite the equity story.

top_risks: Hormuz tanker war re-escalates (today's IRGC strike) and pushes Brent back through $105–110, forcing another G3 hike leg.
Trump–Xi summit fails to extend the Nov 10 Busan truce or produces Taiwan/Iran confrontation language — tariff and chip shock.
Hawkish Warsh SEP + hot Aug PCE (~3.7–3.8% headline) + firm Oct 2 payrolls lock in December +25bp and keep housing in recession.
Graham Act 100% secondary tariffs on China/India Russian-oil buyers get signed into the Xi-visit window.
Yen-carry unwind from BoJ 1.25% overshoots into global credit and EM.
top_opportunities: Bessent–He weekend plus a thin Trump–Xi tariff-cut / truce-extension package would be the cleanest multi-sector risk-on catalyst of the quarter.
Any credible Hormuz ceasefire/transit-normalization would collapse the oil-war inflation premium and ease rate-hike odds.
Micron (Sept 30) as the listed expression of the Korea/AI memory supercycle if pricing/HBM guide stays explosive.
SEC tokenization exemption is a medium-term financials/fintech structural tailwind if venues actually launch.
Consumer trade-down winners (Costco, AutoZone) if real incomes are squeezed but unit demand holds.
summary: The Warsh Fed's 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% with a hawkish SEP is now joined by a live BoJ hike to 1.25% and a still-unresolved Hormuz tanker war (fresh IRGC strike today, Brent ~$102). The two-way overlay for the next two weeks is Sept 19–21 Bessent–He talks and the Sept 24 Trump–Xi summit on ~$30bn tariff cuts versus oil, Taiwan, and a Graham secondary-tariff bill on Trump's desk. Housing is already cracking (starts 1.275M, existing sales 3.98M, Lennar cut) even as nominal retail sales rebounded +1.2%.
